Resolves #21488

🌿 *A cover of this pie can no longer show a frame amCharts had not finished drawing.*

The amCharts wrapper now says when its chart is drawn, the way a Canvas does since #21409. The main-thread addon answers `whenDrawn({id})` once the chart is ready and its data validated, and the wrapper reflects the answer for its latest create or data as `data-drawn`. The `am-charts` card publishes with a cover captured on that signal; neomjs/pages#134 serves it and merges first.

Evidence: L3 (unit arms on stubbed amCharts and a stubbed addon; the recipe captured against the real library in Chromium three times; the live example on this branch) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/main/addon/AmChartsDrawn.spec.mjs` (unknown id; ready, data and a series' data in turn; already drawn; destroyed; replaced) |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/component/AmChartDrawn.spec.mjs` (create answer and `data-drawn`; theme re-create; an overtaken answer; new `chartData`; unmount; `destroy()` without a render; an answer owed at `destroy()`) |
| AC-3 | outside-CI: `node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --record am-charts`, three runs, each sha256 `7032578e…`, 94,251 bytes; served by neomjs/pages#134 |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `MainContainerController.spec.mjs` (unit) and `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` (e2e), with one more published card |

## Deltas from ticket
- `seo.json` needs no change: it carries no image paths.
- `onChartMounted()` now runs on the wrapper. It was handed to `.then()` unbound, so an override reading `this` got `undefined` (none exists in the repository).
- `AmChartTheme.spec.mjs`'s addon stand-in answers `whenDrawn`, because a mounted chart now asks.
- At `942c9684d9` the catalog publishes 107 of 123 records; this branch's only row is Charts, [5, 1].

## Before / after
Charts, Canvas & Maps at 1440 × 900, production build:

| `dev` at `2c268a99ee`: five cards | this branch at `edea980832`: six, amCharts Pie among them |
|---|---|
| ![Charts page on dev](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/f1321fd6b46115e5b8c91e2a91eaaea9be6ba117/review-evidence/21488/charts-before-dev-1440x900.jpg?raw=true) | ![Charts page on this branch](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/f1321fd6b46115e5b8c91e2a91eaaea9be6ba117/review-evidence/21488/charts-after-head-1440x900.jpg?raw=true) |

The frames sit in `f1321fd6b4`, which the next commit removes, so `dev` never carries them.

## Test Evidence
- Mutation: without the request check in `syncDrawn()`, the two overtaken-answer arms fail. Without `clearDrawn()` in `destroy()`, the destroy arm fails with `drawn` still `true`; without the destroying guard in `afterSetDrawn()`, it fails on one render. Restored, all seven pass.
- Live: `examples/charts/index.html` on this branch carries `data-drawn="true"` on `#neo-am-chart-1__wrapper`, with all nine labels drawn.
- At `d9966fff16`: the Portal, build-script and both amCharts unit specs, 1,538 passed; at `942c9684d9` (after #21492) the Portal, docs-build and `AmChartDrawn` specs, 246 passed. The whole suite and `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` run in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] After this PR merges, the Charts, Canvas & Maps page on neomjs.com shows the amCharts Pie card with its cover.
